guitar.evidence: Bernard Butler is known for Fender Telecasters in Suede's early Britpop era; reasonably but not extremely well documented.

tone.target: bright Britpop fuzz-crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright Britpop fuzz-crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic British stack simulation (UK 45) paired with a fuzz/overdrive boost and chorus effect to achieve the required bright, fuzzy Britpop sound.
